scope: Shared protocol and member A conditions; B's methods are pending implementation

rules.target_truncation: flag raw output; empty scored answer; EM/F1 zero; no continuation
rules.optimizer_truncation: reject and retry within the existing phase attempt budget
rules.optimizer_seed: first try uses base seed; retries use the first 32 bits of SHA256([optimizer_retry_v1,base,phase,stage,stage_attempt])
rules.target_seed: fixed experiment seed for each QA request
rules.http_retry: same payload and seed; transport errors, HTTP 429/5xx only; every attempt metered
rules.budget_exhaustion: fail and stop; preserve partial artifacts; no selector substitution
rules.test: disabled by default; explicit final evaluation after method and skill selection freeze
rules.runtime_overrides: only output_root, an approved seed, and explicit allow_test may differ

acceptance.scope: Two-round train/validation acceptance; not research results

model_identity.source_note: User-provided local files; upstream revision has not been independently verified.

source.partition_policy: official_train -> disjoint local train+val; official_validation -> local test
